statusLine.command: input=$(cat); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); total_in=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0'); total_out=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_output_tokens // 0'); ctx_size=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.context_window_size // 0'); total_tokens=$((total_in + total_out)); cost=$(echo "scale=4; ($total_in * 0.000003) + ($total_out * 0.000015)" | bc); [ -n "$remaining" ] && printf "Ctx: %d%% free | Used: %d/%dK | Cost: $%.4f | Tokens: %dK" "$remaining" "$((total_tokens / 1000))" "$((ctx_size / 1000))" "$cost" "$((total_tokens / 1000))"
